section_title: Financial crime risks in relation to other types of risks > Operational, legal, concentration, and reputational risks

propositions.proposition: 当机构因控制薄弱而为人所知时，可能被犯罪分子利用或利益相关者因失去信心而回避
source_quotes: known to have weak controls is then targeted by criminals or avoided by stakeholders who lose confidence

propositions.proposition: 尽管这些风险通常由非金融犯罪防控团队管理，但理解其与金融犯罪风险的关联是不可或缺的
source_quotes: understanding the correlation with financial crime risk is indispensable

propositions.proposition: 全球组织通常以母国监管机构政策为基础标准，再根据东道国法律进行调整
source_quotes: makes the policies of its home regulator its base standard
will then adjust to each host country’s laws

propositions.proposition: 不断演变的法规可能与现有业务模式和控制措施产生错位，合规计划必须持续更新
source_quotes: Evolving regulations might become misaligned with current business models and controls
Compliance programs must continually be updated

propositions.proposition: 法律风险源于可能违反法规、法律和道德实践，政府可能处以行政处罚或罚款，第三方可能提起诉讼
source_quotes: Legal risk stems from potential violation of regulations, laws, and ethical practices
Governments might issue administrative penalties or fines

propositions.proposition: 充分的金融犯罪防控措施可防范犯罪及不当关系
source_quotes: Adequate AFC controls add protection from crime and inappropriate relationships

propositions.proposition: 集中度风险可通过金融犯罪防控与战略多元化来降低
source_quotes: Concentration risk can be reduced by AFC controls and strategic diversification

propositions.proposition: 借助技术的客户尽职调查有助于管理风险敞口
source_quotes: Customer due diligence, enabled by technology, helps manage exposure

propositions.proposition: 风险可能因客户行为或涉及客户的外部行为而增加
source_quotes: Risk could increase through actions by a customer, or external actions involving a customer

propositions.proposition: 信任建立缓慢但丧失迅速，单条新闻（甚至假新闻）即可赶走客户和投资者
source_quotes: Trust takes a long time to earn but can be lost quickly
A single news story—even fake news—can drive away customers and investors

propositions.proposition: 组织的声誉基于其商业实践与道德选择
source_quotes: organizations deserve their reputations...based on their chosen business practices and ethics
